The '''Leaping Tee''' was a family of [[Gados]] [[Acrobat/Legends|acrobats]] during the height of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. They were all members of the [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] [[Alsakan Circo-Menagerie|''Circo-Menagerie'']], a popular traveling show.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
